name: Overlay (floating pill over other apps)
description: The overlay@1 asset on Android: a foreground service (special use) owns a TYPE_APPLICATION_OVERLAY window with a draggable, resizable Compose pill drawn from the app's theme tokens — status chips any module switches (OverlayHost.setChips / setChip), one quick action, a tappable log panel (OverlayLog.add(line, confidence, tag) + tap-line callback, e.g. to tune a trigger threshold), a collapsed strip of the last lines while the pill is hidden (expiry from the engine rules), a mini-screen host any app fills with its own Compose content (OverlayHost.setMiniContent), and a card slot under the pill. Position and size persist in the KV store; Settings → Overlay holds opacity, position lock, panel / strip toggles, mini size and the draw-over-apps permission. Pure rules in the kernel's OverlayEngine (= core/engines/overlay.ts, fixture overlay.json).

params.label: Show the overlay when the app starts

android.note: written without a compiler; CI compiles and runs :lib-overlay:testDebugUnitTest
